task: Units are the words of the text, split on whitespace (use a regex literal, not a string). The reduced series is the character length of each word read so far.

rounds.raw: {"load_body": "units = text.split(/\\s+/);", "unit_count_expr": "units.length", "reduce_body": "readTo = max(2, floor((readTo * fraction))); units = units.slice(0, readTo); return units.map(unit => unit.length);"}
